email.subject: Cracked sidewalk blocking wheelchair access near Library Lane, College Park
email.body:
Hello Building & Landscape Maintenance,

I'm writing to report a problem that needs repair: Cracked sidewalk blocking wheelchair access.

There is a big crack across the sidewalk that wheelchairs cannot get over.

Location: Library Lane, College Park
Exact spot: By the bike racks

Could you please arrange a repair, or let me know if this should go to a different office?

Thank you,

ISSUE_KIND: sidewalk
ISSUE: Cracked sidewalk blocking wheelchair access
DETAILS: Big crack across the sidewalk by the bike racks. Wheelchairs can't get over it.
ORGANIZATION: University of Maryland, College Park — Facilities Management
DEPARTMENT: Building & Landscape Maintenance
WHY: Library Lane (38.985900, -76.944200) is an interior campus footway on the University of Maryland, College Park campus next to McKeldin Library (7649 Library Lane). Although the campus sits inside the City of College Park, the University of Maryland's Facilities Management division maintains campus buildings, grounds, and exterior walkways.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: unknown
COVERAGE_URL: unknown
REPORTING_URL: https://facilitiesservice.umd.edu/
